tool_args.rationale: The short-window positive gain is compatible with endogenous adaptation, but the target horizon is far beyond the observed range. The slow-horizon probe directly tests and calibrates the predicted reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-horizon model to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five rows cover only H ≤ 0.48, leaving slow adaptation and the long-horizon reversal poorly identified.
More short-horizon resolution would not directly resolve the slow timescale relevant at H = 23.6.
It is not relevant to identifying the horizon response.
